lede: The Telluride Film Festival kicks off Friday at the Sheridan Opera House, which means town will be hopping all weekend — plan accordingly. On the government side, Mountain Village's Design Review Board meets Wednesday on a conditional-use permit for a temporary tent and food truck at 332 Adams Ranch Rd, a decision that heads to Town Council, worth watching if you care about what goes up on open-space parcels. Most other agency agendas for the week haven't been posted yet.

notable.stake: Conditional-use permit for tent/food truck on open-space parcels goes to Town Council.
